title: RatsCurrencies
description: A Simple Custom Currency Plugin Which Adds A Shop And A Currency Distribution System For Your Server. This Also Helps To Save The Memory And CPU Usage Which Are Overused In Another Currency Plugin. This Has Very User Friendly Interface [1.18+]
body:
RatsCurrencies - A Unique Economy Plugin
Add a fun and engaging rat-themed currency system to your Minecraft server! RatsCurrency provides a complete economy solution with a custom shop system, rewards, and full Vault integration.

Features
✨ Custom Rat Currency System

Independent economy separate from server money
Automatic rewards for active players
Easy balance management with admin commands
🛍️ Interactive Shop GUI

Beautiful inventory-based shop interface
Display-only items (set price to -1)
Easy item management with commands
💰 Dual Economy Support

Works with Vault for Money economy
Separate Rats economy for special shops
Compatible with EconomyShopGUI
🎯 PlaceholderAPI Integration

%rats_balance% - Player's rat balance
%rats_balance_formatted% - Formatted balance with decimals
Use in chat, scoreboards, holograms, and more
⚙️ Admin Tools

Add/remove/set player balances
Manage shop items easily
Reload configuration without restart
Full LuckPerms permission support
Commands
Player Commands:

/rats - Check your balance
/rats shop - Open the shop
Admin Commands:

/rats add <player> <amount> - Add rats to player
/rats remove <player> <amount> - Remove rats from player
/rats set <player> <amount> - Set player balance
/rats shop add <price> - Add item to shop (hold item, use -1 for display-only)
/rats shop remove <slot> - Remove item from shop
/rats reload - Reload all configurations
Permissions
rats.balance - Check balance
rats.shop - Use the shop
rats.admin - All admin commands
Requirements
Spigot/Paper 1.16+
Vault (for economy integration)
PlaceholderAPI (optional, for placeholders)
LuckPerms (recommended, for permissions)
Configuration
Customize in config.yml:

Reward amount and interval
Starting balance for new players
Currency display name and symbol
Reward notifications
